## Description
Please summarize the changes and the issue they address.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality & Ethics Checklist
- [ ] My code strictly adheres to the non-negotiables in `ETHICS.md`.
- [ ] No author names, institutions, countries, or nationalities are stored, modeled, or returned.
- [ ] No accusatory words (fake, fraud, fabricated, scam, cheat, guilty) are present in code or messages.
- [ ] All unit and property tests pass (`make test` or `uv run pytest`).
- [ ] Code is formatted and linted with Ruff (`make lint`).
- [ ] Any new dependency or data source is documented in `TECH_STACK.md` / `docs/licenses/LOG.md`.
